en: A vintage Greek telegraph postcard (ΤΗΛΕΓΡΑΦΗΜΑ) printed in blue and beige. The layout includes pre‑printed boxes for sender and receiver details, with handwritten Greek text filling some fields and lines. On the left side there is an advertisement for a radio service with a blue flame logo and the word ΡΑΔΙΟΦΩΝΑ. At the top left appears the OTE (Greek telecommunications organization) logo. A circular postal mark is visible on the upper right.
